_doc: Anti-drift compass for the MARKETPLACE DEEPWALK EXPANSION arc (Ian 2026-07-24: 'expand and extend deepwalk journey with this same page, lay out the comprehensive roadmap'). Companion to MARKETPLACE_DEEPWALK_EXPANSION_ROADMAP.md. tools/marketplace_deepwalk_scoreboard.py reads this and emits MEASURED % per type / per phase / per MK class. EXPANSION means growing BOTH denominators: journeys x personas x states (board 1) and new MK dimension classes (board 2) - NOT re-verifying existing UFAI sub-layers (feedback_expand_dimensions_not_reverify).

_phases_def.G: ground - map the steps + surfaces + the code paths
_phases_def.W: walk - live-MCP deepwalk end-to-end carrying the FULL 99-dim lens (never spot-checks); requires >=2 personas AND >=2 states
_phases_def.H: harvest - Engine B night-crawl on a REAL observed friction, or mark clean
_phases_def.R: resolve - dim built / candidate killed / fix shipped / verified clean

_coverage_rule: A journey's W phase is 'done' only when walked in >=2 personas and >=2 states (including S-error or S-empty where reachable). One-persona/one-state = the shallowness this arc exists to kill.

J10-moderation-approve-reject.notes: 2026-07-24: SELF-PUBLISH BYPASS found (non-admin PATCH status=published went live) -> FIXED mig 20260724000003 guard_marketplace_listing_status, verified 42501, deployed prod. REMAINING: the REJECT half - does the seller ever see WHY a listing was rejected? (MK2 detect). | 2026-07-24 REJECT HALF CLOSED (MK2). Found: reject wrote status='removed' with NO reason anywhere (marketplace_listings had ZERO reason columns; the only trace was a hive_audit_log row the seller cannot read) -> the seller saw a bare red 'Removed' chip, no explanation, no path to fix. ALSO FOUND (J20): there are THREE moderation surfaces, not two - marketplace-admin.html AND founder-console.html are both RETIRED behind #wh-retired-overlay (content preserved so ~35 scanners pass) and platform-actions.html is the ONE LIVE surface. Fixing only the admin page would have missed the path actually used. FIX: mig 20260724000005 adds moderation_reason/moderated_at/moderated_by (+ appended to v_marketplace_listings_truth via CREATE OR REPLACE, existing columns untouched); all THREE surfaces now require a reason on reject (whPrompt, cancel-safe, empty rejected) and CLEAR it on approve; the seller dashboard renders a role=alert 'Not approved - <reason>' banner + 'edit and save, it goes back into review'. Privacy is correct by construction: mkt_listings_read = published OR own OR admin, so a removed row + its reason is owner/admin only. VERIFIED LIVE end-to-end through the REAL platform-actions UI (P-admin: modal demanded a reason -> DB row shows status removed + reason + moderated_at) then P-seller (banner renders the exact reason). Test row deleted, 0 leftovers.

J19-listing-to-public-profile.notes: 2026-07-24 FLYWHEEL TURN 1 (P-anon). TWO REAL FINDINGS. (1) FIXED: both listing links on the public profile pointed at 'marketplace.html#listing-<id>' - a HASH form marketplace.html never reads (it reads URLSearchParams.get('listing') and has ZERO location.hash handling). So the visible card href (line 634) dropped a real buyer onto the generic grid (deep-link silent drop, anon-visible), and injectJsonLd (line 573) advertised the same dead URLs to Google (unreachable listings + duplicate-content signal). Both switched to ?listing=<id>; VERIFIED live as P-anon: the deep link opens the CORRECT detail sheet. (2) OPEN FORK: the whole public profile is 'Seller not found' for ANON (incl. Googlebot) because marketplace_sellers RLS is 'auth.uid() IS NOT NULL' while the page is designed public (JSON-LD, anon-visible 'View profile ->' link, no signin gate). Page error-handling is CORRECT; the data policy contradicts the page's intent. Fix direction if Ian wants it public: a SECURITY DEFINER RPC exposing PUBLIC-SAFE columns only (never messenger_username/hive_id) - same pattern as get_seller_community_reputation. NOT built: product/privacy fork (SEO reach vs anti-scraping). | H-HARVEST (spoke 5) RAN: night_crawler Tier-1 --query 'marketplace seller profile public visibility SEO structured data scraping tradeoff' = BAG MISS (only internal doctrine returned: platform book, MARKETPLACE_DEEP_ARC, seo-content skill, 20260706000001_marketplace_rls). Honest result: we have NO external best-practice source on public-marketplace-profile SEO-vs-scraping. OWED: escalate --url to reputable sources (Google Search Essentials / structured-data policy for marketplace listing pages; a marketplace privacy/anti-scraping reference) once the anon-visibility fork is decided - the decision determines which standard we must meet. | RESOLVED (Ian chose 'public, safe columns only'): mig 20260724000004 adds SECURITY DEFINER get_marketplace_seller_public(p_worker_name) returning 16 PUBLIC-SAFE columns; loadSeller falls back to it when the authed view read is empty; injectJsonLd now emits NOTHING when !_seller (no structured data for a not-found page). VERIFIED LIVE as P-anon: profile renders (Romeo Beltran / Bronze / ID Verified / 2 listings), JSON-LD emits real name + aggregateRating + BOTH ItemList urls in ?listing= form. PII CHECK CLEAN: RPC returns 0 of messenger/hive_id/auth_uid, no m.me link in the rendered DOM, contact button display:none for anon (MK3 staging holds). AUTHED REGRESSION CLEAN: full row path unchanged, 2 listings, 0 P1 defects. NOTE messenger_username is NULL on the seed sellers, so the contact button is hidden for BOTH personas here - not a regression.

MK1-trust-signal-integrity.seed: Listing showed '3.9 stars / 1 completed' beside 'No reviews yet' - a rendered trust signal with zero backing rows (local seed). Every displayed trust signal must be derived from a forge-proof canonical source or be suppressed. | 2026-07-24 FIXED: the detail sheet printed a BARE '3.9' with no count directly above a Reviews section reading 'No reviews yet' - two numbers that read as a contradiction (and as a fabricated score). Now: stars render ONLY when a real rating_count backs them (else 'New seller, no ratings yet'), the count is always printed ('3.9 (5 seller reviews)') so the number traces to evidence, and the listing-level list is scoped 'No reviews for THIS listing yet' - distinguishing seller-level reputation from listing-level reviews. VERIFIED LIVE.

MK8-marketplace-safety-fraud.seed: Contact-only free marketplace (PAYMENTS_ENABLED=false) = no escrow, so ALL risk sits at the contact/meet stage. No duplicate/spam/price-anomaly/impersonation detector exists. | 2026-07-24 HARVEST DONE (Engine B, spoke 5): night_crawler --url lawphil RA 11967 -> substrate/external/external-ph-internet-transactions-act-ra11967.md. NOTE the officialgazette PDF was Cloudflare-blocked ('Just a moment...') -> used another publisher of the same statute (the blocked-publisher class). WHAT IT OBLIGATES that maps to code: (a) DTI takedown orders for prohibited/regulated listings -> we now satisfy the record-keeping half via moderation_reason/moderated_by/moderated_at (MK2, same arc); (b) consumer education on the RED FLAGS of internet transactions -> BUILT: a safety notice at the contact step (the exact moment of risk on a contact-only, no-escrow marketplace): inspect first, meet at a business address or public place, avoid full advance payment to a new seller, and an honest 'WorkHive never holds your payment, so we cannot reverse it'. VERIFIED live in the real Contact Seller sheet. (c) Registration with the DTI E-Commerce Bureau + the Online Business Database are BUSINESS-COMPLIANCE items for Ian, not code. STILL TODO: duplicate/spam listing + price-anomaly + impersonation detectors, and a prohibited-goods policy check.

MK9-response-sla-honesty.seed: Detail sheet renders 'Responds in ~1h - 95% reply rate - 1 sale'. Provenance unverified: computed from marketplace_inquiries, or seeded/static? | 2026-07-24 RESOLVED. DEFECT: response_rate/response_time_h were DECLARED in schema and DEFENDED by the trust guard (a seller may not self-assign them) but NOTHING EVER COMPUTED THEM - no trigger, function, edge fn or cron. So the buyer-facing 'Responds in ~1h / 95% reply rate' was a seeded promise about future behaviour that no real event could create, correct or invalidate. (The seller dashboard + public profile computed the same idea correctly from marketplace_inquiries, so only the buyer-facing column was orphaned.) FIX: mig 20260724000006 adds update_seller_response_stats() + a trigger on marketplace_inquiries (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF replied_at,status), computing avg(replied_at-created_at) hours + replied/total, announcing itself via the seller_system_write GUC so the trust guard permits the SYSTEM write. Stays NULL until a first reply so a new seller is never shown a fabricated 0%. BACKFILLED: every seeded seller had ZERO inquiries, so all the fake 0.95/2.0h promises are now correctly NULL. TRIGGER PROVEN: 2 inquiries / 1 replied 3h later -> rate 0.50, time 3.0. LIVE: the detail sheet no longer claims any response SLA. KNOWN GAP: DELETE of an inquiry does not recompute (no delete path exists in the app; inquiries are closed, not deleted).
MK9-response-sla-honesty.distinct_from: MK1 governs trust BADGES/ratings; MK9 governs computed BEHAVIOURAL stats (a promise about future responsiveness).

MK10-ranking-sort-transparency.seed: The grid orders created_at desc with no disclosure of WHY these listings in this order. Ranking transparency is a legal duty for online marketplaces under EU P2B Art.5 and good practice everywhere. | 2026-07-24 FIXED: the grid ordered created_at DESC with NO disclosure, so a buyer could not tell recency from relevance from paid placement. The listings-info line now states it plainly: 'newest first. Sellers cannot pay for placement.' That is the EU P2B Art.5 ranking-parameter duty and, more importantly, an honest answer to 'why am I seeing these?'. VERIFIED live: 'Showing 9 listings - newest first. Sellers cannot pay for placement.'
MK10-ranking-sort-transparency.distinct_from: Net-new. No existing dim asks a ranked list to EXPLAIN ITSELF.
MK10-ranking-sort-transparency.harvest_query: EU P2B Regulation 2019/1150 Article 5 ranking transparency; DSA marketplace duties
